tool_schemas.name: list_subtitle_languages
tool_schemas.description: Returns the available subtitle tracks for the given video URL, including both human-provided and auto-generated captions, grouped by language with the formats available for each. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing or not a valid URL, NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved/ingested from the URL or no metadata can be fetched, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed discovery requests. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access subtitle metadata for the resolved video.

tool_schemas.name: download_video_subtitles
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses) a subtitle download job for the given video URL and optional `language`, selecting an exact match when available and otherwise falling back to auto-generated captions for that language when supported; returns the job record including its current status and any resulting artifact identifiers/locations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is invalid or `language` is malformed/unsupported, NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved or no subtitle track exists for the requested language (including auto-generated), and CONFLICT if an active subtitle job for the same video/language is already in progress and cannot be duplicated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot enqueue jobs for the video and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if job creation limits are exceeded.

language.description: Language code (e.g., 'en', 'zh-Hant', 'ja'). Will try to get auto-generated subtitles if regular subtitles are not available.

tool_schemas.name: download_video
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses) a video download job for the given URL and preferred `resolution` (defaulting to 720p) and returns the job record with status, selected format details, and any resulting artifact identifiers/locations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is invalid or `resolution` is not one of the supported values, NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved or no downloadable video formats are available, and CONFLICT if an incompatible or already-running video job for the same video prevents enqueuing a new one. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot enqueue downloads for the resolved video and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller exceeds download-job limits.

resolution.description: Preferred video resolution. For YouTube: '480p', '720p', '1080p', 'best'. For other platforms: '480p' for low quality, '720p'/'1080p' for HD, 'best' for highest quality. Defaults to '720p'

tool_schemas.name: download_audio
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses) an audio-only download job for the given video URL and returns the job record with status, chosen audio format/bitrate when known, and any resulting artifact identifiers/locations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved or no extractable audio stream is available, and CONFLICT if an active audio job for the same video is already in progress and cannot be duplicated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot enqueue downloads and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller exceeds allowed audio-job volume.

tool_schemas.name: download_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses) a transcript-generation job that downloads subtitles for the given URL and `language` (defaulting to `en`), strips timestamps/formatting, and returns the job record with status and the resulting cleaned transcript artifact reference. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is invalid or `language` is malformed/unsupported, NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved or no subtitle track exists that can be converted into a transcript for that language (including auto-generated fallbacks when applicable), and CONFLICT if a transcript job for the same video/language is already running and cannot be duplicated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create transcript jobs and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if transcript-generation limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_video
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single normalized video record by id, including its current ingestion/status fields and last error details. Returns the video row. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such video exists and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller credentials are invalid.

video_id.description: Primary key of the video record.

tool_schemas.name: list_videos
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingested video records with optional filtering by status/extractor and time range, returning a paginated result set ordered by most recently updated. Refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR and requires valid credentials.

canonical_url.description: Filter by exact canonical URL match.

created_after.description: Return records created at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Return records created before this RFC3339 timestamp.

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor token from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: refresh_video_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Upserts the video by URL (canonicalizing it) and fetches/refreshes metadata via the extractor, transitioning videos.status to 'metadata_fetched' on success or 'error' on failure. Returns the updated video record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid URL, NOT_FOUND if the URL cannot be resolved by any extractor, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed metadata refresh operations.

url.description: URL of the video to ingest/refresh.

force.description: When true, refetch metadata even if already present and status is metadata_fetched/subtitles_fetched.

tool_schemas.name: get_download_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single download job by id, including its current status, attempt counters, runner host, timing fields, and any error information. Returns the job row. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are invalid.

job_id.description: Primary key of the download job.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_download_job
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a download job by id by transitioning status to 'cancelled' when allowed. Refuses with CONFLICT if the job is already succeeded/cancelled or cannot transition to cancelled from its current state, and returns the updated job on success.

job_id.description: Primary key of the download job.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for cancellation (stored in job error_message where applicable).

tool_schemas.name: get_caller_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this service. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the presented credentials are invalid or missing.

metadata.name: yt-dlp Video and Audio Downloader
